games.title: Snake
games.description: Eat, grow, do not hit the wall. Arrow keys or swipe.
rules: Steer with the arrow keys, or swipe on the board.
Eat the red square to grow by one and score a point.
Running into a wall or your own tail ends the round.
Tap the board or press Space to play again.

games.title: Memory Match
games.description: Flip cards and find all the pairs.
rules: Sixteen cards hide eight pairs. Flip two at a time.
A matching pair stays face up. A miss turns back over after a moment.
Every two flips is one move. Find all the pairs in as few moves as you can.

games.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
games.description: Beat the computer. It is not perfect.
rules: You are X and go first. The computer is O.
Take turns marking an empty square.
Three of your marks in a row, column or diagonal wins.
A full board with no line of three is a draw.

games.title: Merge
games.description: Slide tiles, join equal numbers, chase a high score.
rules: Slide every tile at once with the arrow keys or a swipe.
Two equal tiles that meet merge into one tile with their sum, and the sum is added to your score.
A new 2 or 4 appears after every move.
When the board is full and no move can merge, the game is over.

games.title: Reaction Rush
games.description: Wait for green, tap fast. Beat your best time.
rules: Tap the panel, or press Space or Enter, to start. Then wait.
When it turns green, tap as fast as you can. Your time shows in milliseconds.
Tapping before green is a false start and the round does not count.
Five or more taps in a day give Orb a reaction reading for Sleep and mind.

games.title: Lights Out
games.description: Tap a light to flip it and its four neighbors; switch every light off.
rules: Tapping a light flips it and its four neighbours: up, down, left and right.
Switch every light off to solve the board.
Choose Easy 3×3, Normal 5×5 or Hard 7×7. Par is the fewest moves the board needs.
Undo and Restart are always allowed.

games.title: Simon Says
games.description: Watch the four lights and repeat the sequence as it grows.
rules: Watch the four pads light up in a sequence.
Repeat it in the same order by tapping the pads, or with keys 1 to 4 or the arrow keys.
Each round adds one step and plays a little faster.
One wrong pad ends the game. Your longest sequence counts toward Sleep and mind as a memory reading.

games.title: Tower of Hanoi
games.description: Move each disk to the last peg without placing a larger disk on a smaller one.
rules: Move the whole stack from the first peg to the last.
Move one disk at a time, always the top disk of a peg.
Never put a larger disk on a smaller one.
Five levels, from 3 to 7 disks. Par is the fewest moves possible.

games.title: Connect Four
games.description: Drop discs and line up four against the computer.
rules: You and the computer take turns dropping a disc into a column. It falls to the lowest free space.
Four of your discs in a row, column or diagonal wins.
A full board with no four in a line is a draw.
Choose Easy, Medium or Hard before you start.

games.title: Nonogram
games.description: Use the number clues to fill the grid in this logic puzzle.
rules: The numbers beside each row and above each column are the lengths of its runs of filled squares, in order.
Runs are separated by at least one empty square.
Use Fill to fill a square and Mark ✕ to note one that must stay empty.
Twelve levels from 5×5 to 12×12. Every puzzle has exactly one solution.
